d:
From capturing Ayrton Senna in 1983 to shooting 655 Grands Prix, Mark Sutton has seen Formula 1 through a lens like few others
The F1 and Getty Images photographer looks back at his most iconic shots, shares stories about Mika Häkkinen, Lewis Hamilton and Daniel Ricciardo, and offers advice to aspiring motorsport photographers on breaking into the sport. Plus, the story behind the legendary Flying Finn photograph!
Watch F1 LIVE on FanCode with F1 TV
